CONS:

Conclusion; It is a fantastic game, if you overcome the bugs. If you have the spare money then its worth it, if you dont, i recommend you save up for it, as you can always get a steam refund.

9/10

I only have 213 hours in game but i have spent many of those hours having fun whether its in a firefight in milsim or it's king of the hill in a vanilla server.  This game isn't 100% realistic but what game is?  What makes it unique is the attention of detail, situational awarness you need to have, and the fact that there is almost infinitie playtime due to mods and the open platform the game comes in.  This game is especially fun when you know the basics and join a milsim group.  Milsim or (Military Simulator) groups are fun due to the wide spectrum of mods you can choose from.  There are hundreds of different downloadable maps from the workshop and mods that can make the game more realistic if thats what your in to.  I would highly recommend this game to anyone that wants a HARD to play shooter.  This isn't Call of Duty or even Battlefield for that matter; it's meant to still be a realistic shooter regardless of the previous statement.   
                                                                                                                                                                                                       PROS: Repayability is high, Milsim, and Realistic                                                                                                                                CONS: Not optimized on online servers that well (only for super densly populated ares with combat)    <<<P.s. if you have a good enough PC it shouldn't matter
